answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 9 times its size, so a group of 18 keys loses far more than 18 single identities would. The nebula graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the sable audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the whisper checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. That is 35 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
